decision: Use native Qwen text decoding for person slots, boxes, age, gender; route per-person <SEG>/<POSE> hidden states into SAM-style and SimCC decoders consuming Qwen Vision features.
critical_constraint: Qwen Vision is the only mainline image encoder. Exact SAM and ViTPose image encoders are controls only.
consequence: Close HQNet shared-head D and freeze E interface before implementation.
